annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Council Decision authorising the opening of negotiations on behalf of the European Union for a Council of Europe convention on artificial intelligence, human rights, democracy and the rule of law
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Council Decision authorising the opening of negotiations on behalf of the European Union for a Council of Europe convention on artificial intelligence, human rights, democracy and the rule of law
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: European Commission recommendation for a Council Decision authorising negotiations, on behalf of the EU, of a Council of Europe convention on AI, human rights, democracy and the rule of law. It justifies EU competence under Article 3(2) TFEU given overlap with the proposed AI Act and seeks consistency with EU law, a disconnection clause and EU accession.
key_provisions_or_claims: Authorises the Commission to negotiate the Council of Europe AI convention on behalf of the EU.
Grounds EU exclusive competence in Article 3(2) TFEU due to large overlap with the proposed AI Act.
Convention must be consistent with existing and future EU law.
Convention should include a disconnection clause for EU Member States and allow EU accession.
Zero draft: rights for AI subjects, risk-based measures, public sector duties, follow-up mechanism; defence excluded.
